the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: criterion (2) of the algebraic stacks diagonal lemma: for X, Y fp flat proper over S the functor Isom_S(X, Y) sits in the displayed fibre product of Mor functors (bottom arrow sends (phi, psi) to (psi o phi, phi o psi)); the Mor functors are algebraic spaces by proposition-Mor, and algebraic spaces over S have fibre products, so Isom_S(X, Y) is an algebraic space (source lines 3539-3564)
